title.value: BDD-based optimization for the quadratic stable set problem
title.justification: The title is taken from the paper's header, which is the first point of reference for naming a study. It succinctly reflects the main focus of the research.
title.quote: BDD-based optimization for the quadratic stable set problem

extractions.description: This paper explores the quadratic stable set problem (QSSP), which extends the maximum stable set problem and is NP-hard. It proposes a novel representation using binary decision diagrams (BDDs) and a hybrid optimization approach combining BDDs and mixed-integer programming (MIP) to solve the problem. The paper highlights the flexibility of decision diagrams for nonlinear problems and the complementary use of BDD and MIP to explore solution spaces. Machine learning aids in guiding the search mechanisms.
